text:
```yaml
name: Backport PR #4063 to release/7.0

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main

jobs:
  backport:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
    - name: Checkout repository
      uses: actions/checkout@v3

    - name: Set up .NET SDK
      uses: actions/setup-dotnet@v5
      with:
        dotnet-version: '7.0'

    - name: Create backport branch
      run: git checkout -b backport-release-7.0

    - name: Cherry-pick PR #4063
      run: git cherry-pick 4063

    - name: Push backport branch to origin
      run: git push origin backport-release-7.0

    - name: Merge backport branch into release/7.0
      run: |
        git checkout release/7.0
        git merge backport-release-7.0
        git push origin release/7.0
```
